title: Android LinearLayout nested wrap-content row
purpose: Check that a nested wrap-content row resizes with a child's label and moves its following sibling.
changes: A wrap-content LinearLayout now measures the current widths of its children instead of relying on fixed fallback widths.
steps: Find Short, Next and After under Nested wrap-content row. They should appear next to one another.
Tap Change nested label. Short becomes Longer label and grows; Next and After should both move without overlapping. Tap again to restore Short.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and repeat. The order should mirror with all three controls adjacent. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The nested row grows and shrinks with its label and the following sibling stays adjacent in both directions.
limits: This covers supported Bhoo child measurement. Complex weighted nesting, Android font and theme measurement and device parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust regression verifies nested width, sibling positions, runtime label and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified nested width, adjacent siblings and RTL.
